name: Goodlife Health Clubs student discount
summary: 20% off full-priced Goodlife gym memberships for current students at any Australian institution.
key: Goodlife offers students 20% off on full priced month to month, 12 and 18 month memberships.
who: Current student at an Australian institution with a valid student ID.
Aged 14 or over, and not a Goodlife member in the previous 90 days.
how: Fill in the form on the page or visit a club, and bring your student ID.
catches: Subject to the membership contract and terms.
